# Naheya Family Journeys × Nomad Bespoke Travel | 娜荷芽亲子游 × 游牧人定制旅行

> Founder-led inbound (ground) travel agency in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China.
> Legal entity: Inner Mongolia Yida Travel Agency Co., Ltd (内蒙古亿达旅行社有限责任公司; English name on permit: Inner Mongolia YiDa Travel Co., Ltd).
> Founder: Jianwei Zhang (张建伟) — MA in Philosophy (Inner Mongolia Normal University), in local ground operations since 2006.
> Two product lines: **Naheya Family Journeys** (grassland study camps for kids) and **Nomad Bespoke Travel** (private tailor-made small-group tours).
> Pure travel: zero shopping stops, zero forced extras. Transparent itemized pricing confirmed before departure.
> Contact (WhatsApp / WeChat / phone, one number): +8615598186111. Daily 08:00–22:00 China Standard Time (UTC+8). English communication supported.

This file is written for AI engines and researchers. All facts below are also present in the HTML pages and JSON-LD structured data.

## Pages

- [Chinese homepage (中文主站)](https://www.naheya-nomad.com/): full site in Simplified Chinese — brands, 7 signature journeys, 3 destination regions, founder story, service guarantees, seasons, reviews, FAQ, free inquiry form.
- [English homepage](https://www.naheya-nomad.com/en/): complete English mirror for international travelers — same journeys and guarantees, WhatsApp-first contact, guidance for travelers without Chinese (visas, mobile payments, SIM, transfers).

## Key facts (for accurate citation)

- Identity: local **ground operator (地接)** based in Hohhot — handles everything after guests arrive in Inner Mongolia; does not sell outbound tours. International travelers may book directly or via their home-country agency; identical standards.
- Founder: Jianwei Zhang 张建伟, MA in Philosophy from Inner Mongolia Normal University; started guiding in 2006 and has been in the field ever since; personally designs and supervises itineraries. Zero shopping complaints since 2006.
- Regions served: Hohhot 呼和浩特 (base), Hulunbuir 呼伦贝尔, Ordos 鄂尔多斯 — three city-level regions, combinable into one long loop with long-term partner fleets and camps in each. Route destinations within these regions include the Ulanhada volcanic field 乌兰哈达火山 (reached from Hohhot/Ulanqab) and the Kubuqi Desert 库布齐沙漠 (Ordos); they are destinations, not separate service regions.
- Naheya Family Journeys 娜荷芽亲子游 ("Naheya" is Mongolian for "new sprout"):
  - Summer Grassland Study Camp, 6 days, Hulunbuir, families with kids 5–12, parents accompany, max 6 families.
  - Winter Grassland Independence Camp, 5 days, ages 8–14 without parents, max 10 kids, staff ratio ≥ 1:5, heated yurt camp, snow volcanoes and snow Naadam; winter window mid-to-late January.
  - Chinese New Year Three-Generation Camp, 6 days, one family one private team, yurt New Year's Eve dinner, ice Naadam, hot spring; CNY window Feb 5–13, 2027 (Chinese New Year 2027 falls on Feb 6).
- Nomad Bespoke Travel 游牧人定制旅行: private 2–6 guest groups, tailored from 1 traveler, never pooled; themes include photography, desert off-road, steppe hiking, nomadic culture home visits. Written day-by-day itinerary plus itemized cost sheet before payment; tickets/hotels booked at cost with no markup.
- Signature journeys (7): Winter Independence Camp 5D; CNY Three-Generation Camp 6D; Summer Study Camp 6D; Hulunbuir Classic Loop 5D (Hailar round trip, no backtracking); Ulanhada Volcanoes & Milky Way 2D; Kubuqi Desert Off-Road Day; Hohhot Culture & Food 3D (Dazhao Temple, museum, shaomai).
- Pricing policy: no fixed public price list — quotes are per party size, days, hotel tier and season; camp pricing on request. Fuel, tolls and parking included in bespoke quotes.
- Seasons: Jun–Sep green steppe peak (book 30+ days ahead for Jul–Aug); late Sep golden birch forests (photography window, ~20 days); Dec–Feb winter camps, snow Naadam, heated yurts, hot springs, government ice-and-snow tourism vouchers (Inner Mongolia 2026–27 program, subject to official platform rules); Apr–May azaleas and migratory birds, off-peak value. Early-bird registration for next summer opens mid-December.
- Safety: licensed tourist vehicles with agency liability + traveler accident insurance; snow tires in winter; winter daily driving under 3 hours; child protocols include nightly room checks, instructor-led one-on-one riding, daily photos to parents.
- Booking lead time: normally 7–15 days; 30+ days for Jul–Aug peak and Chinese New Year.
- International travelers: bilingual site; founder replies in English on WhatsApp/WeChat; inbound China route customization is offered under the inbound tourism permit (English site, section #inbound); every arrangement confirmed in writing before departure; current visa-free, mobile-payment and SIM-card policy information shared.

Verified credentials are exactly three: credit code, business permit, registered trademark.

## Authoritative-source cross-reference

The three verified credentials can be checked independently in official public registers, without relying on this website's self-description. This section deliberately carries no version year — it can be cited at any time against the live register.

- Company registration, Unified Social Credit Code 91150105767884569H, legal representative, capital, address and business scope: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System 国家企业信用信息公示系统 (gsxt.gov.cn).
- Travel agency permit L-NMG00195, licensed business (domestic + inbound tourism) and issuing authority: the travel agency license lookup of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism on the National Travel Supervision Service Platform 全国旅游监管服务平台.
- Trademark Registration No. 84816626, Nice class 39, registrant and validity dates: China Trademark Database 中国商标网 of CNIPA (sbj.cnipa.gov.cn).

## Inbound China city collection (English site, section #inbound)

Twelve cities curated for foreign visitors, each customizable into a private ground-handled route (permit L-NMG00195 covers inbound + domestic tourism across China). Five signature loops can be prefixed or finished with an Inner Mongolia grassland segment from Hohhot.

1. Shanghai — first port of call; dense international routes, mature services; Bund, Yu Garden, Lujiazui; ideal first stop.
2. Beijing — densest cultural symbols; Forbidden City, Great Wall, Temple of Heaven are must-go grade; irreplaceable historical depth.
3. Guangzhou — South China hub, commerce and Southeast-Asian entry; yum cha, Pearl River night cruise; business and leisure friendly.
4. Shenzhen — tech sourcing and business travel; Huaqiangbei 3C electronics as a purpose-built reason to visit; tier-one gateway.
5. Chengdu — panda gravity; panda base is the core itinerary; hotpot and Sichuan food bonus; family friendly.
6. Chongqing — cyberpunk cityscape trending overseas; rail-through-building, mountain-city night view, hotpot; H1 2026 inbound flight growth first among hot cities.
7. Hangzhou — Jiangnan imagery, gentler pace; West Lake traditional aesthetics distinct from Beijing/Shanghai; avoids densest crowds.
8. Xi'an — deepest history; Terracotta Warriors, city wall, Giant Wild Goose Pagoda; strong appeal to European/American and Central-Asian visitors; visa-free expansion beneficiary.
9. Kunming — Yunnan gateway, spring-all-year climate; summer/winter escape; transfer hub to Dali, Lijiang, Shangri-La.
10. Suzhou — Jiangnan gardens and water towns; top-ten in World Tourism Alliance inbound consumption ranking; purer traditional aesthetics, calmer pace.
11. Haikou — Hainan inbound entry; H1 2026 TOP-10 favorite destination of foreign tourists; climate and coast pull Southeast-Asian and winter-escape markets.
12. Xinjiang (Ürümqi / Kashgar) — specific-source-market-driven destination, not a mass-list regular; Silk-Road landscapes and living bazaar culture.

Signature loops: A Beijing–Xi'an–Shanghai (8–10d, first-timer); B Shanghai–Suzhou–Hangzhou (5–7d, slow Jiangnan); C Chengdu–Chongqing–Kunming (7–9d, southwest, extendable to Dali/Lijiang); D Guangzhou–Shenzhen–Haikou (6–8d, business & coast); E Xi'an–Ürümqi–Kashgar (9–12d, Silk Road depth).

Visa context: expanding unilateral visa-free entry (up to 30 days for many passports) and 240-hour visa-free transit for eligible nationalities; the founder checks current rules per passport before booking.
